headline: A 2022 law renames a federal office building in Cheyenne, Wyoming, after Louisa Swain.
what_it_does: This law gives an official name, the Louisa Swain Federal Office Building, to the federal building at 308 West 21st Street in Cheyenne, Wyoming. It does not change how the building is used, who works there, or any rules that apply to it. The official summary describes only this renaming.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 10, 2022.
